LESSON: MAAGANO

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.16: Maagano

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Maagano. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutumia maneno yanayotumiwa katika maagano kwenye mawasiliano
2. kujibu maagano kwa njia ifaayo ili kudhihirisha ufahamu
3. kuthamini matumizi ya maagano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutumia maneno yanayotumiwa katika maagano kwenye mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia maneno yanayotumiwa katika maagano kwenye mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kujibu maagano kwa njia ifaayo ili kudhihirisha ufahamu
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kujibu maagano kwa njia ifaayo ili kudhihirisha ufahamu. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kuthamini matumizi ya maagano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuthamini matumizi ya maagano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Maagano.
2. Explain Maagano to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Maagano.
4. Show that you can: kutumia maneno yanayotumiwa katika maagano kwenye mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Maagano. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Maagano important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutumia maneno yanayotumiwa katika maagano kwenye mawasiliano
2. kujibu maagano kwa njia ifaayo ili kudhihirisha ufahamu
3. kuthamini matumizi ya maagano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
